subject: Provisioning request: dedicated GPUs for Asterion POC
messages:
From: Alice Cheng <alice@asterion.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Provisioning request: dedicated GPUs for Asterion POC

Hi Karthik / Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed. We have an internal exec window in June to decide on a 6–9 month dedicated POC and need to validate cost + performance at scale. Can Redwood place a soft hold on dedicated GPU capacity while we finish procurement?

Prelim numbers from our infra team:
- Target start: 2029-06-03
- Duration: 3 months (will extend if POC converts)
- Peak: 10 A100-equivalent GPUs (mixed 80/20 steady vs burst)
- Regional preference: us-west (for latency)

If you can place a soft hold, please share:
1) Hold expiry date and conversion window
2) Ticket/ID for the hold
3) Any docs we should route to procurement to accelerate sign-off

I've attached a short workload profile (see attachment).

Appreciate a quick read — we need confirmation before our exec meeting on May 29.

Best,
Alice Cheng
Head of ML Engineering
Asterion Systems
[Attachment: workload_profile_v1.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Cheng <alice@asterion.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning request: dedicated GPUs for Asterion POC

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear numbers and the profile. We can absolutely support a soft hold while your exec team completes the review.

Internal ask (looping Grace & Marissa): can compute-ops confirm inventory and propose a conservative hold that won't block existing commitments? Below are the items we need to lock down:
- Exact instance/sku mix (A100 40GB vs 80GB or equivalent)
- Preferred AZ/region (us-west-2 primarly; fallbacks: us-west-1 or us-east-1)
- Soft-hold expiry (we typically set 7–14 days unless extended by a signed MPA)

Proposed next steps:
1) Ops: run an inventory spot-check and propose a soft-hold quantity + expiry
2) Sales/Procurement: send a short MPA template to procurement@asterion.ai (Grace)
3) I'll confirm with the exec team once hold is in place

Grace — can you draft the MPA + include the procurement contact? Marissa — can you help coordinate the allocation ticket with compute ops?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning request: dedicated GPUs for Asterion POC

Folks — ran an availability sweep across the US pool this morning. Quick findings (live snapshot attached):
- us-west-2: A100-80GB free nodes: 28, A100-40GB free nodes: 42 (after accounting for scheduled maintenance windows)
- us-west-1: A100-80GB free nodes: 10
- us-east-1: A100-80GB free nodes: 36

Constraints to note: we have a confirmed Dedicated Reserved commit for Q3 that may reduce usable headroom around 2029-07-15 — however, for the early-June start a soft-hold is feasible.

Recommendation: place a soft-hold for 12 A100-equivalents in us-west-2 (gives a 20% buffer for burst). Proposed soft-hold terms:
- Quantity: 12 A100-equivalents
- Region: us-west-2 (primary), fallback us-west-1
- Hold ID: CP-78321 (SOFT-HOLD)
- Expiry: 2029-06-10 23:59 PDT unless converted to Reserved or extended by signed MPA
- Conversion note: if a final MPA is signed before expiry we convert the CP-78321 hold to a reserved allocation and update billing terms

Attachments: gpu_inventory_snapshot_20290521.csv, proposed_capacity_hold_slide.pdf

Marissa — can you open the formal allocation ticket with SRE/Capacity (include CP-78321 in title) and route to the capacity ops queue? Include a note that this is a late-stage deal (AST-2029-0432) — priority: P1 soft-hold for sales conversion. Also add a request for an automated alert 72 hours prior to expiry so we can escalate.

Karthik / Grace — I'll keep the snapshot updated daily and will note any changes if the Q3 reserved commit moves earlier.

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2029 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning request: dedicated GPUs for Asterion POC

Hi Alice — quick update from our side.

We placed a soft-hold under ticket CP-78321 for 12 A100-equivalents in us-west-2 (soft-hold expiry: 2029-06-10). Attached is a one-page summary for procurement and a short MPA draft (Grace is copying you separately with the MPA).

What you need to do to convert the soft-hold to reserved allocation:
- Review and sign the MPA (Grace will send) — target sign-by: 2029-05-30 to fit your exec window
- Confirm exact sku mix if you prefer 80GB vs 40GB instances (default is 80GB unless you request otherwise)

Ticket: CP-78321 (SOFT-HOLD)
Conversion window: sign MPA by 2029-05-30 to guarantee allocation before hold expiry

Grace — please send the MPA and cc procurement@asterion.ai. Lukas / Marissa — please monitor CP-78321 and alert the sales thread 72h before expiry.

Alice — let me know if you want a short call tomorrow to walk procurement through the MPA.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
